newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE wheat futures end mixed, buck stg strength.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE wheat futures end mixed, buck stg strength.

text.p: LIFFE wheat futures ended mixed after managing to stay stronger than sterling's strength would have implied, traders said.
The last trades were between 0.30 stg lower and 0.10 stg higher, according to contract.
Buyers had been impressed by the consistent strong volume of trade this week, with good underlying buyer support into lows. However, a trade dinner meant that many were absent Friday, traders said.

But sterling keeps the market nervous. "I think if we didn't have sterling as a factor they'd like to bid it up," one trader said. "Traders are definitely becoming more friendly to the market," he said.
The contrast between fairly active futures and a dead physical market is stark, traders said.
Later in the day, the market did try to follow sterling's oscillations, ending near to lows.
Active May wheat last traded 0.30 stg lower at 94.50 stg, close to a low of 94.45, and well off the high of 95.15. There were 208 lots of May traded, of a total 515 lots.
There were no trades in barley.
